name: Meta-labeled perp-basis discount reversion (long spot)
rationale: META-LABELING on a BASIS primary — a third orthogonal meta-label lane (the existing two gate momentum/RSI; the funding-contrarian meta is a sibling in this wave). PRIMARY (permissive, decides SIDE only): long spot when perp_spot_basis is below a fitted discount floor (perp trades cheap to spot / shorts over-paying — a crowded-short squeeze setup). SECONDARY regularized-logistic gate decides ACT vs SKIP, trained expanding-window + PIT on which barrier each PAST basis-discount entry hit first netted of cost, reading: perp_spot_basis, funding_rate, ret_Nd, rsi, vol_realized. The secondary only sizes/skips, never flips direction. Economic bet: the basis-discount reversion is real but fails when the discount reflects a justified sell-off rather than transient short-crowding; the secondary reads funding/momentum/vol to separate the squeeze setups from the falling knives — the regime classification the bare basis floor (as in perp-basis-discount-contrarian-long-spot) cannot do. Distinct from perp-basis-discount-contrarian-long-spot (same primary, NO secondary model), metalabel-momentum, metalabel-reversion, and g2-metalabel-funding-contrarian (funding primary, not basis). HONEST PRIOR: meta-labeling only amplifies an existing edge; if the bare basis primary is fee-dead, this is a powered FAIL run cleanly. Disconfirmer 1: the secondary must ADD deflated Sharpe over the bare primary, not merely cut trades. Disconfirmer 2: must beat a random skip of the same trade fraction. tier0 perp_spot_basis primary + orthogonal meta features, fresh prod data — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: the secondary model green-lights a perp-basis-discount long in a regime where the squeeze-reversion has historically paid
